def slugify(title)
  title
    .downcase
    .gsub(/[^\p{Alnum}]+/u, "-")
    .gsub(/\A-+|-+\z/, "")
end

if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  require "minitest/autorun"

  class SlugifyTest < Minitest::Test
    def test_converts_title_to_slug
      assert_equal "hello-world", slugify("Hello, World!")
    end

    def test_collapses_separators_and_trims_edges
      assert_equal "ruby-is-great", slugify("  Ruby -- is  great!  ")
    end
  end
end
